title: Search in a Rotated Sorted Array
description:
A sorted array of distinct integers was rotated at an unknown pivot (for example 0 1 2 4 5 6 7 became 4 5 6 7 0 1 2). Find the index of a target value, or report that it is not present.

Input format
Line 1: n and target separated by a space.
Line 2: the n integers of the rotated array.

Output format
The 0-based index of the target, or -1 if it is absent.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000. All values are distinct. Aim for O(log n).
hints: After the rotation, one of the two halves around the middle element is always still sorted. How can you tell which?
Compare a[lo] with a[mid]. If a[lo] <= a[mid] the left half is sorted; otherwise the right half is sorted.
Check whether the target lies inside the sorted half (using its end values). If it does, search that half; otherwise search the other half.
